summary: Setting "spectatorsGenerateChunks" to false and relogging freezes the game on the Loading Terrain screen
description: This is bad. I was trying to spectate my hardcore world after dying, but got stuck in unloaded chunks at my respawn point. Due to this gamerule being set to false when you die in hardcore, I thought to exit out of the world, turn on cheats, and force the chunks around me to load. Because I couldn t load any chunks, my hardcore world cannot load, thus freezing the game at the "loading terrain" screen, which softlocks the game. How to reproduce - Die in hardcore. Make sure your death point and spawnpoint are far away from each other. - If you get trapped in unloaded chunks, relog from the world. If not, open the world to LAN amd try again. - Try to open the world. - Sit in your chair for the rest of forever waiting for your world to load.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Hardcore world with default settings.
3. Ensure that the "spectatorsGenerateChunks" gamerule is set to false.
4. Die in the Hardcore world.
5. Confirm that your death point and spawn point are far away from each other.
6. Relog into the Hardcore world. 
7. Wait at least a few minutes and observe that the game freezes on the "Loading Terrain" screen.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.18.2, 22w11a, 22w12a, 22w13a, 1.19 Pre-release 3, 1.19 Pre-release 5, 1.19, 1.19.1 Pre-release 4, 1.19.2 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior: When the gamerule "spectatorsGenerateChunks" is set to false and a player relogs after dying in hardcore mode, the game freezes on the Loading Terrain screen. This issue arises when a player attempts to spectate their hardcore world after death but finds themselves trapped in unloaded chunks at their respawn point. Since the gamerule prevents chunk loading upon death, the player may attempt to exit the world, enable cheats, and force the surrounding chunks to load. However, if no chunks can be loaded, the game becomes unresponsive, resulting in a freeze at the Loading Terrain screen, which effectively softlocks the game. To reproduce this issue, a player should die in hardcore mode, ensuring that the death point and spawn point are significantly distanced from each other. If the player becomes trapped in unloaded chunks, they should relog from the world; if that does not work, they can try opening the world to LAN and repeat the process. Ultimately, the player will be left waiting indefinitely for their world to load, unable to progress.
Expected Behavior: When "spectatorsGenerateChunks" is set to false, relogging should allow the player to load their hardcore world without freezing on the Loading Terrain screen. Instead of being trapped in unloaded chunks at the respawn point, the game should seamlessly generate and load the necessary chunks, enabling the player to continue spectating their world without encountering a softlock. This behavior should be consistent across all versions of the game.
